Systems integration

Up-to-date opportunities in HubSpot and AWS Partner Central.

Cloudfianz connected HubSpot with AWS Partner Central so sales opportunities update automatically across both platforms.

Cloudfianz's work
Two-way integration
Connected platforms
HubSpot and AWS Partner Central
Scope
AWS opportunities and benefits

The client

Escala24x7 is a cloud services company operating in more than 19 Latin American countries. As an AWS Premier Partner, it supports migration, data, security, artificial intelligence and managed services.

The challenge

Two platforms that needed to work together

Before the project, opportunity management relied on AWS Partner Central, AWS's partner portal. While it handled the commercial relationship with AWS, it did not cover comprehensive sales management in a dedicated CRM.

Digifianz began implementing HubSpot, and the need to connect both systems emerged. AWS-generated opportunities in Partner Central had to reach the sales team in HubSpot. Conversely, opportunities created by Escala24x7 needed to appear in AWS without another manual entry.

Without that connection, keeping both platforms aligned required team intervention and left room for incomplete or outdated information.

The solution

Two-way opportunity synchronization

Escala24x7's sales and operations teams can work with shared information without manually duplicating every opportunity.

Cloudfianz built an integration using AWS APIs that connects HubSpot and AWS Partner Central opportunities in both directions. The solution also synchronizes the benefits AWS grants its partners.

Compatible data, automatic synchronization.

The main challenge was standardizing information. HubSpot properties were created to match AWS Partner Central's required fields, so each system receives data in the structure it needs.

Triggers were also designed inside HubSpot to start synchronization. This handled the workflow without adding external licenses or tools for that function.

The results

A shared view of the pipeline

Sales can track AWS opportunities from HubSpot. Client and project information flows between platforms, and both sales and operations teams use the integration in their daily work.

  • Less manual entry

    Opportunities synchronize in both directions without someone having to duplicate them.

  • Unified sales information

    Tracking can be done from HubSpot with data coming from AWS.

  • Less reliance on manual updates

    There is less risk of an opportunity failing to appear in the other platform.

  • Better coordination

    Sales and operations share current information to manage opportunities and respond to clients.

Next steps

An integration that keeps evolving

After two years of collaboration, work continues on extending benefits automation from HubSpot to an internal Escala24x7 system. This expansion is in development and deepens the connection between the CRM and the company's tools.
